box_inside_provenance.length_width: Manufacturer-published internal box dimensions; user's copy not measured in X/Y.
box_inside_provenance.height: User measured internal height 100 mm; agrees with manufacturer-published internal dimensions.
box_inside_provenance.edition_note: Internal dimensions may vary by a few mm with printing/edition. Insert footprints are not box dimensions.

flat_components.map_estimate_assumption: Each expansion map has the same folded thickness as the average base map; not measured.
flat_components.common_mats_note: User confirmed the measured base 4 mm includes both the Legends mat and Championship mat. Do not add their thickness again.

boards_mats_rules_stack_height_scope: All 4 folded double-sided maps, all base/expansion player mats, base Legends and Championship mats, and all base/expansion rulebooks. The base common mats are already included in the measured 4 mm. Exact maximum stack height is not measured.

provisional_layout.height_formula: 100 - 60 - 2 = 38; includes all tray bases, lids, spacers and stacked tray layers.
provisional_layout.fit_condition: Complete flat stack must be <= 60 mm. User's box X/Y must accommodate footprint with clearance. Recompute if either fails.
provisional_layout.scorepads_note: Measured whole scoreboard bundle100x60x7mm stored in dedicated lower tray; capacity10mm. Removed from upper flat-stack allocation.

card_compartment.note: Internal dimensions, not tray exterior. Add walls, base and lid separately within the provisional organizer envelope. Final clearance and deck capacity require fit verification.

notes: Base game plus up to 2 expansions. Exact expansion names not confirmed. null means not measured or confirmed. 25 mm is base maps only; 4 mm includes all base player mats, Legends mat, Championship mat and rulebooks. Do not add the two common mats again. 50 mm and the 60/38 mm layout are provisional, not measurements. Demo is not final design.
sleeved_card_provenance: User provided sleeve outer size 58 x 89 mm.

sleeved_card_stack_measurement.scope_note: The measured 24-card pack matches confirmed stored player set basic12+starting3+stress3+heat6.
sleeved_card_stack_measurement.compression_note: 8.8 mm was measured under force. Use approximately 9 mm plus removal clearance for compartment sizing.
sleeved_card_stack_measurement.estimate_formula: For preliminary planning only: card_count * 9 / 24 mm. Re-measure actual larger decks before final design.

race_car.axis_interpretation: width x length x height from three user values

gear_pawn.upper_profile_assumption: Entire gear within 15mm cylinder; only base diameter measured.

weather_tokens_bundle.axis_interpretation: first two values are footprint, third is stored stack height

road_condition_tokens_bundle.axis_interpretation: first two values are footprint, third is stored stack height

token_fit_candidate.note: Placed behind the v0.5 compact car/scoreboard tray. Original WeatherLower compartments cannot fit these measured bundles.
